sun._help: Average sunrise / sunset for Des Moines around the 15th of each month (local clock time, DST included). The Home landscape blends between months so the sky shifts a little every day.

sync._help: Coins, chores and approvals sync through Supabase (project ervin-data, schema ervin_central, table ops). The key is the PUBLISHABLE key — safe in this public file; never put the secret key here. pollSeconds = how often a visible screen checks for other devices’ changes.

passcodes._help: SHA-256 hashes of the 4-digit codes, salted with "ervin-central:". dad and mom each open that parent's Parent management area (their house's coin jars, approvals, adjustments); kids is asked every time a kid adds coins. siteTools names the parent whose code also opens sync, backup and wipe. To change one: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update('ervin-central:1234').digest('hex'))" and paste the result.

_birthdays_help: Birthdays with a kid id (the girls) are always pinned to the Countdowns card. Everyone else competes with major holidays for the other 4 of 6 countdown slots. Birthdays also show on the calendar.
_kids_help: color = the girl's own color everywhere (Evelynn orange, Avery yellow); green is the whole family. art = an image used in her hexagon avatar instead of the emoji (Evelynn's orange butterfly).
